display_name: Maharana Pratap & Man Singh at Haldighati
one_line: Opposing Rajput leaders facing each other in the Battle of Haldighati, 1576 CE, in the hills of Mewar.

appearance.age_look: Both appear in their mid-30s, athletic and battle-hardened, with sturdy builds suited to armoured cavalry leaders.
appearance.face: Maharana Pratap has a strong oval face, wheatish-tan Mewari complexion, high cheekbones, straight nose, thick moustache with short trimmed beard, a faint scar on his left cheek, and a focused, resolute expression; Man Singh has a slightly broader face, fairer Rajput complexion, neatly curved moustache, small trimmed beard, calm but intense eyes, and a composed, commanding expression.
appearance.hair: Both wear their hair tied back unseen under turbans; Maharana Pratap wears a mustard-yellow Mewari pagri with a broad red band, a small metallic crescent ornament at the front and a short green plume; Man Singh wears a rich deep-red Mughal-Rajput turban with a central gold sarpech and a dark teal feather, fabric folded neatly in layered pleats.
appearance.costume: Maharana Pratap wears a fitted quilted cotton angarkha in muted off-white with faint vertical stitching, over which sits a steel-coloured mail shirt peeking at the sleeves and hem, and a sleeveless bronze-toned steel breastplate with simple raised edges, paired with deep-emerald green churidar-style trousers, a wide crimson cloth kamarband wrapped multiple times around his waist, brown leather belt with a simple brass buckle, soft brown leather riding boots to mid-calf, and minimal jewellery—only a thin gold earring in one ear and a simple black-threaded protective amulet around his neck; Man Singh wears a knee-length, full-sleeved yellow-gold silk jama (wrap-around coat) with a subtle diagonal weave pattern, tied to the right with a teal sash, over partial mail visible at the collar and cuffs, with a sleeveless polished steel breastplate edged with engraved floral borders, deep-azure blue churidar trousers, a broad dark-red cloth kamarband with a hanging fold on one side, tan leather riding boots, and a simple gold armlet on one upper arm plus small gold stud earrings, giving him a dignified Mughal-Rajput courtly look ready for battle.
appearance.signature: Maharana Pratap carries a long slightly-curved Rajput steel sword with a disc pommel and cross-guard in a plain brown leather scabbard at his left hip and also holds a round steel dhal shield with a darkened surface and four brass bosses; Man Singh carries a curved Mughal-Rajput talwar with a gently flared tip, ornate hilt and black scabbard with subtle gold fittings at his left hip and holds a polished round shield with a central boss and minimal floral etching.

ref_desc: Maharana Pratap has a wheatish-tan face with a scar, thick moustache, mustard-yellow turban with red band and green plume, off-white quilted angarkha, steel mail and bronze breastplate, emerald trousers, crimson kamarband, brown boots, Rajput sword and steel shield, while Man Singh has a fairer face with curved moustache, deep-red turban with gold sarpech and teal feather, yellow-gold silk jama over mail, steel breastplate, azure trousers, dark-red kamarband, tan boots and an ornate talwar with polished shield, all in mustard yellow, deep red, emerald green, steel grey and yellow-gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two opposing armoured Rajput leaders at Haldighati: Maharana Pratap with a wheatish-tan oval face, high cheekbones, thick moustache, short trimmed beard and a faint scar on his left cheek, wearing a mustard-yellow Mewari turban with a broad red band, small metallic crescent ornament and short green plume, his hair tied unseen beneath; his outfit is a modest off-white quilted cotton angarkha with visible vertical stitching, over a steel-grey mail shirt at sleeves and hem, topped by a sleeveless bronze-toned steel breastplate with simple raised edges, paired with deep-emerald green churidar trousers, a wide crimson cloth kamarband wrapped tightly at the waist, a brown leather belt with brass buckle, and soft brown leather mid-calf riding boots, carrying at his left hip a long slightly-curved Rajput steel sword in a plain brown leather scabbard and holding a dark steel round dhal shield with four brass bosses; beside him, Man Singh has a slightly broader fairer face with calm intense eyes, neatly curved moustache and small trimmed beard, wearing a deep-red Mughal-Rajput turban folded in layered pleats, set with a central gold sarpech and dark teal feather, his hair tied beneath, dressed in a knee-length full-sleeved yellow-gold silk jama with a subtle diagonal weave pattern wrapped to the right and tied with a teal sash, over partial mail at collar and cuffs and a sleeveless polished steel breastplate engraved with a floral border, deep-azure blue churidar trousers, a broad dark-red cloth kamarband, and tan leather mid-calf riding boots, carrying on his left hip a curved Mughal-Rajput talwar in a black scabbard with subtle gold fittings and holding a polished round shield with a central boss and light floral etching; show both characters in neutral full-body poses with consistent anime proportions, clearly displaying face shapes, turbans, layered garments, kamarband, boots, swords and shields in a palette of mustard yellow, deep red, emerald green, steel grey and yellow-gold, against a simple plain background.
